manifest.name: dsh-unity-mcp-bridge
manifest.description: Opt-in Unity-MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: dormant by default, /unity-mcp-tools activates it, ships the 1.6.0 command catalog plus /unity-mcp-install, /unity-mcp-delete, /unity-mcp-check, /unity-mcp-update and /unity-mcp-update-tools.

bundle.text:
# The plugin row ships with the bundle, because installing the package has to be
# enough to make it active. A bundle whose patch inserts no row installs as
# "installed but not in effect": nothing instantiates it, and a desktop profile
# that regenerates its own cordis.patch.yml from its settings store drops any row
# you added there by hand, so the plugin silently stops working after a restart.
#
# The default endpoint is the standard Unity-side one: gamedev-mcp-server.exe
# listening on port 20000, mounted at /mcp. The token-carrying /p/<pin> path is
# an alternative mount on that same listener, not a different port.
#
# To point this profile's row somewhere else, override it in YOUR layer (the
# profile's cordis.patch.yml) with a plain id entry - not a second insert:
#
#   - id: unity-mcp
#     config:
#       url: http://localhost:20000/p/<your-token>
#
# See README.md for the full configuration table and the install procedure.
- insert:
    - id: unity-mcp
      name: 'dsh-unity-mcp-bridge'
      config:
        serverName: unity
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://localhost:20000/mcp
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
        # After a call to any listed tool returns, this bridge re-fetches
        # tools/list itself and swaps the registry, instead of waiting for the
        # server's tools/list_changed notification.
        resyncAfterTools:
          - tool-set-enabled-state
        # Safety-net periodic re-sync in ms (0 = off).
        resyncIntervalMs: 0

readme.text:
中文 → [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that bridges a Unity MCP server (`com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp` / AI Game Developer) into DSH. It stays dormant until you ask for Unity.

- Dormant from boot: no connection, no Unity tools — two hook tools, ~224 tokens.
- `/unity-mcp-tools` then `unity_mcp_activate` connects and registers `mcp__unity__*`.
- Enabled commands take effect on the **next** step; `unity_tools_restore` disables them and disconnects.
- Ships the command catalog for plugin 1.6.0 (19 commands, RQL-first; regenerable from the offline package via `/unity-mcp-update-tools`) and the `/unity-mcp-install` / `/unity-mcp-delete` / `/unity-mcp-check` / `/unity-mcp-update` / `/unity-mcp-update-tools` skills.
- `resyncAfterTools`: after a management-tool call the bridge re-fetches `tools/list` itself, because DSH's long-lived session never receives `list_changed`.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/xiake-1/dsh-unity-mcp-bridge.git
```

`<profile>` is `web` (`dsh web`) or `desktop`. Restart the app. The shipped bundle patch inserts the `unity-mcp` row (`http://localhost:20000/mcp`) itself — nothing to write by hand.

Override the row only when this profile uses a different endpoint, in `%DSH_HOME%/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: unity-mcp
  config:
    url: http://localhost:20000/p/<your-token>
```

| Entry | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/unity-mcp-install` | Installs the Unity-side plugin and the MCP Server into the workspace's Unity project |
| `/unity-mcp-delete` | Uninstalls the Unity-MCP plugin and its extensions, cleaning config and cache leftovers |
| `/unity-mcp-check` | Checks plugin install, port 20000, DSH bundle loading, minimal tool set and catalog version, then runs the connect test |
| `/unity-mcp-update` | Checks the official CLI, the local `vendor/` offline package and the Unity plugin for updates; upgrades only after you agree |
| `/unity-mcp-update-tools` | Refreshes the offline package and regenerates the `/unity-mcp-tools` command and extension indexes |
| `/unity-mcp-tools` | Opens Unity capability: activate → find the command → enable only what the task needs |
| `unity_tools_restore` | Disables everything except the management tool and returns to dormant |

Everything else — configuration fields, the offline `vendor/` package, catalog regeneration, self-test — is in [docs/DETAILS.md](docs/DETAILS.md); measured feature comparison in [FEATURES-AND-COMPARISON.md](FEATURES-AND-COMPARISON.md).
